Extract aggregated catch data (either at 1x1 or 5x5 gridcell) from the BEST database

get_aggregated_effort.Rd

Queries best.A_BEST_AGG for effort (effort type determined by the selected gear) summed by flag, gear, species, year and location, with optional filters to include/exclude specific flags, gears, species, years, and to restrict to the WCPFC convention area.

Usage

get_aggregated_effort(
  in_wcpfc = TRUE,
  year = NULL,
  flag = NULL,
  gear = NULL,
  exclude_flag = NULL,
  exclude_gear = NULL,
  exclude_species = NULL,
  fine_scale = FALSE
)

Arguments

in_wcpfc

Logical; if TRUE (the default), restrict results to the WCPFC convention area.

year

Optional numeric vector of years (YY) to include. Defaults to NULL (all years).

flag

Optional character vector of flag codes to include. Defaults to NULL (all flags).

gear

Optional character vector of gear codes to include. Defaults to NULL (all gears).

exclude_flag

Optional character vector of flag codes to exclude. Defaults to NULL.

exclude_gear

Optional character vector of gear codes to exclude. Defaults to NULL.

exclude_species

Optional character vector of species codes to exclude. Defaults to NULL.

species

Optional character vector of species codes to include. Defaults to NULL (all species).

group_flags

Logical; not currently implemented (see Note). Defaults to FALSE.

group_gears

Logical; not currently implemented (see Note). Defaults to FALSE.

group_species

Logical; not currently implemented (see Note). Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A data frame with columns FLAG_CODE, GEAR_CODE, SP_CODE, YY, sum_catch_mt, latd, lond, and data_source and aditional columns for the effort metrics, which are determined by the gear selected.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_aggregated_effort(year = 2020:2023)
get_aggregated_effort(in_wcpfc = FALSE, exclude_gear = "S")
} # }
